description: Manages the various types of documents associated with different entities within the system, such as partners, projects, or interactions.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of document types, optionally filtered by an associated entity name. Supports pagination and ordering of results.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to filter document types by (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project', 'Interaction'). If not provided, all document types are returned.

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

orderBy.description: The field name to order the results by (e.g., 'Name', 'Id').

ascending.description: Specifies whether to sort in ascending (true) or descending (false) order. Defaults to true.

example_uses: List document types specifically for 'Partner' entities.
Retrieve the second page of document types, with 20 items per page, ordered by name.
Find all document types associated with 'Project' entities, sorted in descending order by their creation date.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch a list of predefined document types, either globally or specific to a particular entity, for display or selection purposes in a user interface or automated process.
